hypothesis: The detail pathname and being the first rendered article are not sufficient identity evidence after the original article virtualizes away. Fixtures confirmed a timestamp-less first reply inherits the main post ID. A first reply with an unusable or external timestamp link also authorizes its poster under the main ID in retained facts. Separately, pathOf(undefined) became /undefined, hiding the valid plain-date fallback in the ordinary no-time case. These are independently reproduced DOM defects, not an established cause of the actual current playback failure.
decision: First reproduce the unsafe fallback with isolated rendered DOM fixtures, without claiming it is the current real video failure's cause.

For a missing timestamp permalink, accept the current detail path only for the first outer article when its own author profile matches the path's handle and an exact same-origin permalink occurs outside quotes and nested articles.
Exclude linkless/partial quote containers from identity proof even when they lack a time element. Preserve normal timestamped identities and bounded observed poster retention.
No private state, guessed IDs, synthetic media URLs, credentials, social mutations, native policy changes, actual app restart or playback acceptance claim.
acceptance: After the main article virtualizes away, a timestamp-less first reply with no exact own permalink cannot inherit the detail ID.
Missing permalink, wrong author, cross-origin or credentialed permalink, quote-only permalink, later article and non-detail document cannot use the fallback.
A valid first detail article with a plain-text date, matching own author and exact same-origin permalink remains supported.
A correctly timestamped reply remains identified under its own ID and its poster remains in only that scope.
Existing detached-quote/attributeOldValue poster guards and all projection relation/quote/pin behavior remain intact.

verification.tests: tools/run_frontend.ps1 test: xCleanProjection 49, xRenderedMedia 21, xVideoIntent 12 and xAction 9; all 91 passed. Existing unknown-relation, quote, pinned/repost, detached-poster and single-action guards pass unchanged.
verification.limits: No native file or playback policy changed; no native build, actual desktop operation, network or account write. These fixes are not represented as the observed live video's root cause or as successful actual playback.
